name: Moekko Nurse
source:
Main character is a physician who works at hospital. He is successful with nurses there, but he is only interested with pure girls. Finally he finds a suitable patient to project all his tenderness to.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名在医院工作的医生。他在那里的护士方面很成功，但他只对纯洁的女孩感兴趣。终于，他找到了一个合适的病人来表达他所有的温柔。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
